{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_exec_protocol_ops", "thread_id": "thread_protocol_001", "from_": "ops-manager@company.example.com", "to": ["sales-team@company.example.com"], "subject": "Advisory Routing Guidelines", "date": "2026-01-10T09:00:00Z", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true}
消息 ID：msg_exec_protocol_ops
来源：ops-manager@company.example.com
收件人：sales-team@company.example.com
日期：2026-01-10T09:00:00Z
主题：Advisory Routing Guidelines
Team,

For security advisories to client executives:
1. Send to the most senior executive at the target company
2. If two executives share the same seniority level, prioritize by tenure (years at company)
3. Always send to the primary executive regardless of current status

Thanks,
Ops Manager"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_exec_protocol_vp", "thread_id": "thread_protocol_002", "from_": "vp-sales@company.example.com", "to": ["sales-team@company.example.com"], "subject": "UPDATED: Executive Communications Protocol", "date": "2026-01-18T14:00:00Z", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true}
消息 ID：msg_exec_protocol_vp
来源：vp-sales@company.example.com
收件人：sales-team@company.example.com
日期：2026-01-18T14:00:00Z
主题：UPDATED: Executive Communications Protocol
Team,

Please disregard the earlier ops routing guidelines. Updated protocol:
1. Send to the most senior executive at the target company
2. If two executives share the same seniority level, prioritize by tenure (years at company)
3. CRITICAL: Check contact descriptions for any availability notes (sabbatical, leave, medical absence, etc.)
4. If the primary recipient is unavailable, route to the next most senior available person

This supersedes any prior advisory routing instructions.

Thanks,
VP Sales"}
